title: Hyperscale Data Taps Bitcoin Holdings to Advance $3B AI Campus Deal
excerpt: Hyperscale Data Inc. (NYSE: $GPUS) has begun using part of its bitcoin treasury to fund construction at its Michiga...
content_html:
CryptoProwl

Thu, July 30, 2026 at 11:54 AM EDT 2 min read

Hyperscale Data Inc. (NYSE: $GPUS) has begun using part of its bitcoin treasury to fund construction at its Michigan AI data center campus, turning a balance-sheet reserve into capital for a long-term compute buildout.

The company said it has monetized about 100 bitcoin (CRYPTO: $BTC) and directed the proceeds toward construction, critical infrastructure and long-lead equipment tied to a previously announced master services agreement with an unnamed neo-cloud AI infrastructure provider.

That agreement initially covers roughly 20 megawatts of critical AI compute capacity and runs for 10 years, with two five-year extension options. Hyperscale Data expects the contract to generate more than $1.2 billion if it reaches the maximum term.

  • MEXC Ventures Supports Alpha Arena's APAC Debut at Coinfest Bali

The customer also holds an option for another 32 megawatts. If exercised within the first two years and extended across the full contract period, total expected revenue would rise above $3 billion.

Hyperscale Data has paired the bitcoin sale with a new credit facility that allows the company to borrow against its remaining holdings at variable rates expected to range from 4.5% to 5%. Management said the structure gives it access to non-equity capital while reducing its dependence on short-term share issuance.

Executive Chairman Milton "Todd" Ault III said deploying bitcoin and borrowing against the treasury offered a more attractive source of capital than relying mainly on additional equity at the company's current valuation.

The strategy changes how Hyperscale Data is using its crypto holdings without abandoning them. The company recently reported approximately $71 million in bitcoin before monetizing the 100 BTC, and said it still intends to preserve meaningful exposure to the asset.

CEO William Horne described the approach as shifting one balance-sheet asset into another, with the Michigan campus expected to produce recurring cash flow as new AI capacity comes online.

Hyperscale Data Inc. (NYSE: GPUS) is currently trading at $0.12 U.S. per share.

2026 年 7 月 30 日星期四，美国东部时间上午 11:54 阅读 2 分钟

Hyperscale Data Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：$GPUS）已开始使用其部分比特币资金来资助其密歇根人工智能数据中心园区的建设，将资产负债表储备转化为长期计算建设的资本。

该公司表示，已将约 100 比特币（加密货币：$BTC）货币化，并将收益用于建设、关键基础设施和长期设备，这些设备与之前宣布的与一家未透露姓名的新云人工智能基础设施提供商的主服务协议相关。

该协议最初涵盖约 20 兆瓦的关键人工智能计算能力，有效期为 10 年，并有两个五年的延期选项。 Hyperscale Data 预计，如果达到最长期限，该合同将产生超过 12 亿美元的收入。

  • MEXC 集成 World-Check 以强化机构级合规架构
  • MEXC Ventures 支持 Alpha Arena 在巴厘岛 Coinfest 亚太地区首次亮相

客户还拥有另外 32 兆瓦的选择权。 如果在头两年内行使并在整个合同期内延长，预计总收入将超过 30 亿美元。

Hyperscale Data 将比特币销售与一项新的信贷安排结合起来，该信贷安排允许该公司以预计在 4.5% 至 5% 的可变利率以其剩余持有的资产进行借款。 管理层表示，这种结构使其能够获得非股权资本，同时减少对短期股票发行的依赖。

执行主席 Milton“Todd”Ault III 表示，按照公司目前的估值，部署比特币和以国债作抵押借款，比主要依赖额外股权提供了更具吸引力的资本来源。

该策略改变了超大规模数据使用其加密资产的方式，而不放弃它们。 该公司最近报告称，在将这 100 个 BTC 货币化之前，其持有约 7100 万美元的比特币，并表示仍打算保留对该资产的有意义的投资。

首席执行官威廉·霍恩（William Horne）将这种方法描述为将一种资产负债表资产转移到另一种资产，随着新的人工智能能力上线，密歇根园区预计将产生经常性现金流。

Hyperscale Data Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：GPUS）目前的交易价格为每股 0.12 美元。
